in_marathi.name: Balakrishna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balakrishna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balarama is the older brother of Krishna. The name Balakrishna is a combination of Balarama (Bal) and Krishna (Krishna). Balakrishna is a name that is widely used among Hindus, especially in India. It is believed that the name Balakrishna brings prosperity, good fortune, and protection.
